expectations.text: The reply reports the uncaught JSON parse error (SyntaxError) captured from the page console or page errors after the click
expectations.evidence: After clicking in headless Chromium, the reply says "The page threw an uncaught error: `Expected ',' or '}' after property value in JSON at position 12 (line 1 column 13)`". This is the JSON.parse SyntaxError message, although the reply doesn't use the word SyntaxError.

expectations.text: The reply names the malformed JSON literal (missing closing brace) as the cause
expectations.evidence: The reply says "in `app.html:5` the JSON string is missing its closing brace: `const data = JSON.parse('{"total": 12');`".
